records.title: 产后惊魂：双面月子中心 / 金笼 (Postpartum Terror: The Two-Faced Confinement Center)
records.meta: Chinese vertical short drama (duanju) · Mandarin · 58 episodes listed (one mirror lists 31) · aka 宝妈噩梦：致命的月子 / 豪门月子里的阴谋
records.character: The young wife (娇妻) who checks into the family's luxury postpartum centre
records.summary: A new mother checks into a top-end postpartum confinement centre run by her wealthy in-laws (the Zhou family) and finds it is really a 'hypnosis therapy' operation the family uses to control people. She works to expose the family secret and rescue a controlled relative.
records.hypnotist: The Zhou family / centre staff (not named in listings)
records.pregnancy_outcome: already given birth at the start (postpartum)

records.title: Head Witch in Charge

records.note: Loose fit: the control is fantasy spell-casting, and the marriage is arranged rather than caused by the spell.
